phasePlans.name: Multi-model review
phasePlans.exit: Released reviewer, finding, API and authenticated dashboard workflow with explicitly synthetic success/failure/recovery demonstrations and real GitHub customer acceptance. Inaccessible external model-provider validation may remain deferred/unverified only after all other applicable gates pass, under releases/m3-provider-validation-exception.json. Preserve original requirements and full M0–M10 scope; qualified closure does not establish live compatibility, quality or independence.

prs.title: Scope and API design
prs.acceptance: Audit cross-cutting requirements and schema examples; freeze provider/review/finding contracts, versioning, budget policy and acceptance corpus before implementation. Record mandatory retro dependencies, live-provider prerequisites, coding-provider identity, initial OIDC/session decision and exact release/demo scenarios; no paid calls without configured authorization and total budget.

prs.title: Native image publication and bounded cleanup
prs.acceptance: Build AMD64/ARM64 on native runners with pinned runtime-layer reuse, immutable digest assembly and explicit post-build timeout margin. Verify failed/partial publication retention, both platform scans/runtime gates and record matched-cache timing before claiming acceleration.

prs.title: Deployment and provider preflight
prs.acceptance: Read-only preflight checks actual daemon-shared migration/provider paths, credential references, endpoint connectivity, configured spend limits and service readiness before webhook or live-provider mutation. Missing/unshared files and unauthorized endpoints fail with redacted actionable errors; preserve unrelated state.

prs.title: Evidence reuse and delivery measurement enforcement
prs.acceptance: Record evidence by product source, artifact digest, platform and verifier revision; require invalidation reasons for repeated acceptance. Separate CI/publication/download/cycle/blocker/intervention/rework cohorts, preserve failed attempts, and make one consolidated closure record the default. Reject wrong-source/digest/coverage reuse.

prs.title: Provider core and bounded execution
prs.acceptance: Normalized invoke/stream/capabilities/extensions and usage; cancellation, bounded retries, unsupported-feature errors and budget exhaustion tests.

prs.title: OpenAI adapter
prs.acceptance: Official provider integration behind core; request/stream/schema conformance, redacted errors, live opt-in smoke and outage tests. Live acceptance deferred by owner decision; original criterion retained, no completion claim.

prs.title: Anthropic adapter
prs.acceptance: Same conformance corpus; explicit feature translation/unsupported capabilities; live smoke without secret leakage. Live acceptance deferred by owner decision; original criterion retained, no completion claim.

prs.title: xAI adapter
prs.acceptance: Same conformance corpus plus live smoke; do not assume endpoint similarity proves compatibility. Live acceptance deferred by owner decision; original criterion retained, no completion claim.

prs.title: Independent reviewer roles
prs.acceptance: Seven configured roles, different-provider policy, trusted context and prompt-injection evals; record model/config/context digests.

prs.title: Finding lifecycle and reproduction
prs.acceptance: Deterministic dedupe, evidence links and all lifecycle transitions; isolated reproduction hooks; consensus alone cannot establish confirmation.

prs.title: Customer/API/check integration
prs.acceptance: Review CLI and API operations with compatibility coverage, exact-head Checks, independent-provider dogfood, unsupported claims and confirmed regression demo; decide optional router/later adapters explicitly. Account-free demonstrations use explicitly synthetic provider fixtures; live-only claims remain deferred under docs/phases/m3-live-validation-deferral.md.

prs.title: Next.js UI foundation and packaging
prs.acceptance: Next.js App Router React/TS shell with Tailwind and reviewed shadcn/Radix source, theme/accessibility tokens, Zod UI-input contracts; production standalone UBI image startup, build/license/security checks and no server secrets in client bundles. Data views stay unavailable until authenticated routes ship.

prs.title: Browser session and authorized API access
prs.acceptance: Server-managed secure sessions/OIDC decision, authorization on every Next.js server data route, tenant/repository scoping and contract-checked API access; no operator bearer tokens or App/provider keys in browser assets. Unauthorized, expired, CSRF and cross-tenant cases fail; sensitive data is not shared by caching.

prs.title: Initial web control-plane dashboard
prs.acceptance: Read-only Next.js/React/TypeScript with Tailwind/shadcn/Radix PR dashboard shows exact head, review/eval status, risk, confirmed/unconfirmed findings, model disagreement and evidence links. Authenticated backend access, tenant isolation, accessible empty/error states and live customer walkthrough; never embed operator/App credentials in browser assets.

prs.title: Release and demo
prs.acceptance: Publish verified CLI/service artifacts; fresh customer review, provider failure recovery and released-build success/failure demo; close all gates and retro. Account-free demonstrations use explicitly synthetic provider fixtures; live-only claims remain deferred under docs/phases/m3-live-validation-deferral.md.

phasePlans.name: Instrumentation
phasePlans.exit: Released Python and TypeScript SDKs export correlated OTLP traces; the AgentCI control plane traces its own model/tool operations.

prs.title: Telemetry contracts and privacy
prs.acceptance: Version AgentCI semantic mapping and event attributes; per-field capture modes, metadata-only defaults, redaction/encryption/local-storage policy fixtures.

prs.title: TypeScript SDK
prs.acceptance: Instrument existing clients and manual spans; context propagation, errors/cancellation, opt-out and no hidden reasoning capture.

prs.title: Python SDK
prs.acceptance: Equivalent behavior and shared fixtures; supported Python matrix, async/manual spans and installed wheel smoke.

prs.title: OTLP and backend integration
prs.acceptance: Reuse OTel collector/exporters; W3C propagation, bounded buffers, backend outage/backpressure and metadata/content boundary tests.

prs.title: Trace API and explorer linkage
prs.acceptance: Authorized trace references, PR→eval→trace navigation and CLI inspection; tenant isolation, retention and safe Kubernetes correlation IDs.

prs.title: Control-plane dogfood and velocity
prs.acceptance: Trace AgentCI model/tool/handoff/policy/side-effect operations; correlate task/PR/CI spans and critical-path waits; unknown cost/human effort remains unknown.

prs.title: SDK/service release and demo
prs.acceptance: Publish npm/Python artifacts and changed UBI images, clean installed SDK examples, trace-backend outage demo, download verification and retro.

phasePlans.name: MCP Gateway
phasePlans.exit: Real tool discovery and invocation pass through the released gateway, with visible traces and enforced allow/deny/approval policies.

prs.title: Gateway contracts and transport
prs.acceptance: Pin current MCP capabilities/transports against official spec; client/server boundary, session lifecycle, version negotiation and cancellation fixtures.

prs.title: Discovery and schema snapshots
prs.acceptance: Forward discovery, namespace collisions and immutable tool revisions; server annotations cannot define trusted policy.

prs.title: Authentication and identity
prs.acceptance: Auth integration/passthrough with scoped identity; denied tenant, token audience and credential forwarding/leak tests.

prs.title: Policy and human approval
prs.acceptance: Structured allow/deny/approval, side-effect classification and rate budgets; approval identity/expiry, replay resistance and no unauthorized side effects.

prs.title: Tracing and redaction
prs.acceptance: Correlate invocation/result/policy evidence; redact before export/storage and preserve useful metadata during upstream failures.

prs.title: Gateway deploy and adversarial acceptance
prs.acceptance: UBI service, health/shutdown/upgrade docs and burst/outage/injection tests against real safe MCP servers; SDK/API/client example.

prs.title: Release and demo
prs.acceptance: Publish/download gateway artifacts; demonstrate allowed, denied and approval-required tools with evidence; customer setup and retro.

phasePlans.name: Release evidence
phasePlans.exit: A verified release can be reconstructed to exact source, spec, evals, artifacts and model/tool/policy inputs; tampering is rejected.

prs.title: AgentRelease contracts and immutability
prs.acceptance: Canonical schema, all required digests, versioned identity, API/CLI contracts and storage migration; finalized records cannot be overwritten.

prs.title: Bundle construction and storage
prs.acceptance: Content-addressed manifests, bounded evidence references, tenant authorization, retention and independent reconstruction verification.

prs.title: Signing and verification
prs.acceptance: Use existing signing/attestation standards; identity/trust policy and offline verification; altered digest, wrong signer and missing artifact rejection.

prs.title: GitHub CI integration
prs.acceptance: Build/verify/publish evidence from trusted source; idempotency and stale/cancelled CI rejection; agent-readable release API and CLI.

prs.title: Promotion decision records
prs.acceptance: Configured stage gates and actor/policy/window/evidence records; explicit fail behavior and Argo integration boundary, never replace GitOps.

prs.title: Reconstruction and velocity experiments
prs.acceptance: Fresh reconstruction plus missing/tampered evidence failures; measure safe affected-check reuse/merge-queue experiments with immutable inputs and full release checks.

prs.title: Release and demo
prs.acceptance: Publish/download signed evidence and service/CLI artifacts; demo exact reconstruction and rejection; migration/rollback guide and retro.

phasePlans.name: Tekton/OpenShift distribution
phasePlans.exit: A real OpenShift sample PR executes through Tekton and produces signed AgentRelease evidence with verified operator status.

prs.title: Platform ADR and CRDs
prs.acceptance: Choose supported OpenShift/OLM/operator toolchain; platform-neutral domain linkage and AgentProject/AgentRelease/AgentPolicy schemas with upgrade tests.

prs.title: Tekton analysis/eval task catalog
prs.acceptance: Semantic diff, risk, eval and model-review tasks use released core; pin inputs and isolate untrusted workspace; real TaskRun fixtures.

prs.title: Evidence/attestation tasks
prs.acceptance: Evidence publish/release attest tasks reuse M6 verifier; replay task compatibility contract explicitly awaits M9, not fake replay success.

prs.title: Pipelines as Code and Results
prs.acceptance: Real PR pipeline, scoped App integration, durable Results links, retries/cancellation and stale-head rejection.

prs.title: Tekton Chains verification
prs.acceptance: Signed provenance linkage binds all release digests; tampering and untrusted signer fail; avoid duplicating Chains.

prs.title: Operator reconciliation
prs.acceptance: Go/controller-runtime operator for CRDs, conditions and evidence reconciliation; RBAC, restart/idempotency and failed verification tests.

prs.title: OpenShift packaging/integrations
prs.acceptance: OLM bundle/install/upgrade, OAuth/RBAC, OTel and GitOps configuration; restricted SCC and UBI images; dynamic console plugin decision explicit.

prs.title: Real cluster customer acceptance
prs.acceptance: Fresh install and sample live PR→Tekton→signed Verified release; failed signature, outage/restart and upgrade/rollback demo rehearsal.

prs.title: Distribution release and demo
prs.acceptance: Publish operator/bundle/tasks/service artifacts; verify registry downloads and clean cluster installation; live released-build demo and retro.

phasePlans.name: Production feedback
phasePlans.exit: A seeded production-like failure produces a correctly linked incident with confidence and evidence, visible through API and UI.

prs.title: Outcome/incident contracts
prs.acceptance: Outcome taxonomy, idempotent ingestion, versioned events, tenant/retention/privacy rules and schema migrations.

prs.title: SDK/OTLP/gateway ingestion
prs.acceptance: Normalize existing trace/gateway signals with release identity; redaction, duplicates, out-of-order data and backpressure tests.

prs.title: External alert adapters
prs.acceptance: Versioned adapters for logs/metrics, Kubernetes/audit, Sentry-like and PagerDuty-like sources plus feedback/invariant signals; choose first live integrations explicitly.

prs.title: Candidate incident engine
prs.acceptance: Deterministic triggers for error/policy/alert/anomaly/feedback/invariant/deployment; dedupe, threshold and infrastructure failure distinctions.

prs.title: Correlation evidence
prs.acceptance: Trace/release/SHA/resource/causal references and confidence; time proximity alone never proves causality; ambiguous fixtures remain ambiguous.

prs.title: Incident and application UI/API
prs.acceptance: Authorized timeline/evidence/application health and outcome client; accessible views, pagination, empty/error states and tenant tests.

prs.title: Operational/velocity analytics
prs.acceptance: Workload-specific quality/cost/latency, PR/CI/release lead time and blocker metrics; explicit denominators/unknowns; controlled burst-load and seeded incident acceptance.

prs.title: Release and demo
prs.acceptance: Publish/download changed services/UI/SDKs; customer seeded failure and ambiguous-correlation demo, retention/recovery docs and retro.

phasePlans.name: Replay and regression
phasePlans.exit: A seeded incident meets a configured reproduction threshold and becomes a stable regression that fails before the fix and passes after it.

prs.title: Replay package contracts/privacy
prs.acceptance: Immutable incident/release/policy/fixture identity, local-only storage and capture consent; required fixtures/expected outcomes validated.

prs.title: Recorded replay
prs.acceptance: Deterministic orchestration replay with model/tool fixtures; no uncontrolled external side effects; missing fixtures are infrastructure/inconclusive results.

prs.title: Simulated and ephemeral replay
prs.acceptance: Curated state and isolated real-tool environments, cleanup/resource limits; label replay fidelity and wire M7 replay task once implemented.

prs.title: Reproduction orchestration
prs.acceptance: Temporal cancellation/retry/restart and configured repeated-trial thresholds; never mark one convenient retry as confirmation.

prs.title: Regression generation and approval
prs.acceptance: Stable case IDs and minimized context; explicit expected behavior provenance; human approval for inferred high-impact expectations.

prs.title: Customer/API/CLI acceptance
prs.acceptance: Replay client and evidence navigation; seeded case reproduces and committed/stored regression runs in future PR checks; privacy and failure demos.

prs.title: Release and demo
prs.acceptance: Publish/download replay tools/services/task updates; fresh install, before/after regression demonstration and replay limits, recovery docs and retro.

phasePlans.name: Repair orchestration
phasePlans.exit: A seeded incident produces a verified repair PR without human code authoring, preserving human merge/production authority.

prs.title: Repair contracts and autonomy
prs.acceptance: Repair/approval APIs, versioned policies and separate permissions for every action; human merge/approval/production defaults, actor audit and threat model.

prs.title: Evidence-based root-cause workflow
prs.acceptance: Eleven cause classes and validated hypotheses; confidence/provenance, ambiguity and provider outage; no unsupported root-cause certainty.

prs.title: Isolated candidate patches
prs.acceptance: Bounded N candidates from coding adapters; workspace/credential separation, cancellation and artifact retention; cannot alter authoritative judging evidence.

prs.title: Verification and candidate selection
prs.acceptance: New regression, affected/full suites by risk, security/policy/cost checks; choose by recorded evidence, reject empty tests/LLM preference-only selection.

prs.title: Branch/PR automation
prs.acceptance: Repository-scoped write permissions with explicit installation decision; exact verified candidate SHA, idempotency and no unsolicited merge/deploy.

prs.title: Repair UI/API and recovery
prs.acceptance: Human approval and incident→repair→release linkage; force-push/stale evidence, crash recovery and partial PR creation tests.

prs.title: End-to-end customer dogfood
prs.acceptance: Seeded incident→replay→regression→candidate→verified repair PR; reject unsafe patch and forged evidence; measure elapsed cycle/cost/rework.

prs.title: Release and demo
prs.acceptance: Publish/download all changed artifacts; live repair PR and blocked unsafe candidate demo; product-wide DoD audit, security/scale acceptance and retro.
